page_pair_semantics.reading: first token = the cited Act's OPENING page in the bound volume; second token = the cited section's PINPOINT page. NOT a start/end span.
page_pair_semantics.corpus_evidence: distinct (volume, first-token) keys carrying more than one second token -- impossible under a span reading
